title: 17990 - 17990/P1582/005506
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Sensör okuma hatası veya tesisat temassızlığı
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Intake System for Leaks (False Air)
Kontrol edin:  Evaporative Emission (EVAP) Canister Purge Regulator Valve (N80)
Kontrol edin:  Exhaust System for Leaks
Kontrol edin:  Secondary Air Injection (AIR) for Leaks
Kontrol edin:  Vacuum Lines for Leaks
technicalNotes:
It may be necessary to remove and clean the Gaz Kelebeği Ünitesi and Gerçekleştirin: a Gaz Kelebeği Ünitesi Alignment (TBA)
When this fault is stored in the early VW models with the 2.8L VR6 (AAA) and the 2.0L (ABA), it may be necessary to drive the vehicle for a few days for the idle to return to normal after removing and cleaning the Gaz Kelebeği Ünitesi. If that is still not successful then disconnecting and reconnecting the car's battery cables may be necessary to allow the fault to be cleared.
